name: @bongtu/client-solana
description: bongtu Solana rail client — the @solana/kit-typed layer beside @bongtu/client-evm: the signMessage key-derivation payload (the Solana analogue of the EIP-712 seed) and login identity wiring with the stricter first-derivation determinism guard, consumer op transaction building (instruction encoding from the @bongtu/core/solanaOps layout table, the mandatory SIMD-0385 v1 header-config budget from the committed CU budgets (no ComputeBudget instructions on the wire), pre-send Transaction v1 size assertion), the consumer submit io bundle, and the public-feed self-scan adapter. Depends on the rail-agnostic engine (@bongtu/client) and satisfies its structural rail seam; the engine never imports this package (gated by the engine's railFree suite).
